info.title: KarryGo Vendor Service - Section 13 Platform Taxonomy Administration
info.description: Section 13 platform canonical taxonomy administration: versions, drafts, facets, nodes, governed vocabulary, publication, governance cases, platform-scope mapping and semantic assignment, and append-only seed evidence. This surface decides how every vendor on the platform is classified and discovered, so it is root-mounted and reachable only with serviceauth HMAC-v2 plus an explicit caller allowlist and durable nonce replay protection. No vendor role grants vendor.taxonomy.platform.admin and there is no bearer route here to grant it on.
